description: `cli org --help` prints the `cli org` topic (`org list` and the organization commands).

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli org <COMMAND> [ARGUMENTS] [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  list                        List the organizations this account belongs to.
  show                        Show one organization; ORG may be default.
  create                      Create an organization.
  default                     Choose this account's default organization.
  invitation                  Commands: accept, revoke.
  invite                      Invite an account.
  member                      Commands: list, remove, role.
  rename                      Change an organization's display name.

Examples:
  prose cli org list --json
  prose cli org show acme-research --json
  prose cli org create acme-research --name 'Acme Research' --yes
  prose cli org default acme-research --yes
  prose cli org invitation revoke acme-research 7e6d5c4b-3a29-4817-8f6e-5d4c3b2a1908 --yes
  prose cli org invite acme-research ACCOUNT_ID --role developer --yes
  prose cli org member list acme-research --json
  prose cli org rename acme-research 'Acme Labs' --yes

Global options:
  --output human|json|jsonl   Output mode; the same as the PROSE_OUTPUT setting.

Run `prose cli org <COMMAND> --help` for details. `prose cli service operations --json` prints every command as JSON.
